topic: How a solar cell generates electricity

scenes.narration: A solar cell is built from several layers: glass on top, n-type silicon, the p-n junction where the action happens, p-type silicon below it, and a metal contact at the base. Electrons freed at the junction flow toward the n-side creating current.
scenes.visualDescription: Layers of a solar cell with electron carriers crossing the junction.
scenes.concept: A solar cell converts light to electricity via a semiconductor junction between stacked layers.

visual.title: Inside a Solar Cell
visual.footnote: Photons kick electrons across the junction, generating direct current.
